items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1968-11-30
items.q: I wanted to get a chance to hear him but I never did.

ctx.x: You were just on records. I was around Chicago. I wanted to get a chance to hear him but I never did. He was working in the loop at that time. I was only there for a couple of days. I didn't get a chance to hear him.
But did he have much of a reputation?
